seo.title: How it works — TripAgent
seo.description: One message. A named advisor plans, books and looks after every journey — flights, hotels and visas — and stays with you until you are home.

hero.lede: Tell us where you'd like to go. A named advisor takes it from there, and stays with you the whole way.
hero.jumpLabel: See how a trip comes together

model.note: Two parts: a person who knows you, and quiet help behind them that never sleeps.
model.statementHtml: A real person, who answers fast.
model.lede: Your advisor knows how you travel, holds the fares, and checks every detail before you pay a rupee. Technology keeps them fast. You only ever speak to the person.

steps.heading: Five steps. The last one is where everyone else stops.

items.heading: You send a line
items.body: Greeted by name, answered in moments, by someone who knows how you travel.

items.heading: A few good options
items.body: Two or three worth your time — never a wall of results. You see the price, not the workings.

items.heading: Your advisor confirms
items.body: A person holds the fare, checks the detail, locks it in. Nothing is booked without them.

items.heading: You pay, plainly
items.body: Points or card, taxes shown, one tap. Documents and visas arrive in the same thread.

items.heading: We stay until you're home
items.body: A change, a delay, a flight rebooked before you wake — handled. We check in after you land.

journey.headingHtml: From a wish to a journey.
ledes: A real exchange. Answered in moments, suites held, visas filed before you've decided — all in one thread.
No portal. No forms. No queue. A person who already knows you, on the app in your pocket.

messages.text: An anniversary in May. Italy — seven nights, somewhere unforgettable.
Lovely. Lakes and old-world rooms over crowds — does that sound right?
I'll keep it intimate. Holding three suites while you decide.

pq: A flight rebooked before you wake — handled.

rescue.headingHtml: The difference shows at 2 a.m.
ledes: Anyone can sell a ticket. The test is when it goes wrong — a storm, a strike, a missed connection in a city you don't know. That's when one person who already has your details is worth everything.
Most disappear the moment you pay. We do the opposite.

messages.text: Our flight home was just cancelled.
Already rebooked — 9:40 tomorrow, same cabin, no change fee. Rest.

sig.headingHtml:
Most stop when you pay.
We stay until you are home.
sig.lede: Enquiry, booking, departure, the trip, the way home — every step, including the ones no one else shows up for.
